description: Pure capability facts only. Everything else emerges from agent decisions.

events.fact: Economy functioning normally. Self-driving vehicle technology exists but is not deployed locally. Millfield is a car-dependent small town.
RoboRide Inc announces expansion to 50 new cities. Millfield is listed for Phase 2 deployment, expected in 2 months.
RoboRide launches autonomous ride-share service in Millfield. Price: $0.18 per mile. Average wait time: 15 minutes. Coverage: main roads and commercial areas.
RoboRide drops price to $0.12 per mile. Wait time now 8 minutes. Coverage expanded to residential areas. Partnership with local delivery companies announced.
RoboRide announces 24/7 coverage, 5 minute average wait, $0.10 per mile. Autonomous delivery service also launched. Second robotaxi competitor enters Millfield market.
